Name: Scale
Description: The scale of the overall field of shapes. Controls the size of the tectonic plates or regions generated by the node.

Name: Range
Description: Adjusts the variation in elevation or intensity between different plates, affecting the contrast and diversity of the generated regions.

Name: Falloff
Description: Controls the smoothness of the transitions between plates. Higher values create softer, more gradual boundaries; lower values produce sharper edges.

Name: Warp
Description: Applies distortion to the plate boundaries, introducing irregularity and natural variation to the shapes.

Name: Angle
Description: Sets the orientation or rotation of the plate pattern, allowing you to control the directional flow of the generated regions.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different plate arrangements while keeping other settings the same.
